description_en: Queries the details of the dictionary list for a specified type
description_zh: 查看指定类型的词典列表详情
kebab_example: aliyun elasticsearch list-dicts --analyzer-type IK --name SYSTEM_MAIN.dic --instance-id es-cn-0ju29ifnc00050000 --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDicts

parameters.description_en:
The dictionary type. Valid values:

- IK: IK cold update dictionary.

- IK_HOT: IK hot update dictionary.

- SYNONYMS: Synonym dictionary.

- ALIWS: Alibaba dictionary.
parameters.description_zh:
